summary: Examples of with_sequence creating formatted test users, even-numbered directories, groups via count, a countdown with negative stride, and an end from a variable.
questions: How do I create users testuser00 to testuser20 in hex?
How do I create directories with even numbers?
How do I use a variable as the end of a sequence?

answer_card.title: with_sequence examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    state: present
    groups: "evens"
  with_sequence: start=0 end=32 format=testuser%02x

- ansible.builtin.file:
    dest: "/var/stuff/{{ item }}"
    state: directory
  with_sequence: start=4 end=16 stride=2

- ansible.builtin.group:
    name: "group{{ item }}"
    state: present
  with_sequence: count=4

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item }} seconds to detonation"
  with_sequence: start=10 end=0 stride=-1

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item }}"
  with_sequence: start=1 end="{{ end_at }}"
```
